population_requirements.chronology: Use a later, prespecified chronological interval relative to model freeze; do not choose dates or boundaries until an eligible source and label-maturity process are confirmed.
population_requirements.duplicates_and_overlap: Document transaction identity/deduplication where available. Ensure calibration and confirmation cohorts are disjoint in target observations and temporal windows; length-10 sequences must not cross cohort boundaries.
population_requirements.label_maturity: Define a label-maturity window and censor/incomplete-label policy before cohort extraction; unresolved labels must not be treated as legitimate.
population_requirements.prediction_time_features: Require proof that each feature and transformation is available at the actual scoring time; prohibit post-outcome or adjudication leakage.
population_requirements.provenance: Record source system, extraction query/version, timestamps, dataset content hash, label policy/version, and custody/access history.
population_requirements.quality_and_drift: Predefine missingness, schema, label delay, temporal drift and exclusion reporting; retain chronological ordering.
population_requirements.representativeness: Compare the target population and fraud prevalence to the intended operating population using documented covariates, without post-hoc cohort selection.

protocol.candidate_identification: Choose and freeze the candidate set using evidence permitted for development; do not select candidates on confirmation outcomes.
protocol.independent_confirmation: Evaluate the frozen candidate and frozen policy once on a separate, later or otherwise independently governed cohort that was not used for fitting, checkpoint/model selection, threshold tuning, or candidate choice.
protocol.metrics: Report AP (sklearn average_precision_score) and ROC-AUC as ranking measures, plus policy-relevant threshold measures only at a threshold frozen before confirmation. Report denominators, prevalence, confusion counts, and missing-label handling.
protocol.missing_labels: Specify the label-maturity cutoff and report excluded/unresolved rows. Do not impute unresolved outcomes as non-fraud.
protocol.multiple_comparisons: Prespecify candidate comparisons and distinguish exploratory ranking from confirmatory claims; account for the planned family of comparisons or limit confirmatory claims to a prespecified primary comparison.
protocol.reproducibility: Persist cohort definition, row/class counts, source and label hashes, artifact/scaler/metadata/source hashes, Git revision and dirty status, software versions, seeds, metrics, and protocol/policy versions.
protocol.score_semantics: Report supervised fraud probabilities separately from Autoencoder reconstruction-error anomaly scores; do not call anomaly scores probabilities or compare calibration without a separate calibration study.
protocol.temporal_alignment: For LSTM/GRU, independently form length-10 windows within each cohort; assign scores to the final row only and omit the first nine rows in each cohort. No window may cross train/calibration/confirmation boundaries.
protocol.threshold_calibration: If an operational decision requires a threshold, calibrate it on a designated calibration cohort after objective/capacity constraints are approved, then freeze threshold and policy before confirmation.
protocol.uncertainty: Prespecify the resampling unit and temporal dependence assumptions. If transaction dependence is plausible, use justified temporal blocks/sensitivity and report event counts; do not treat row bootstrap as resolving temporal or selection bias.

known_limitations: The validation common cohort contains 56 fraud observations; uncertainty and subgroup estimates are fragile.
Temporal model targets are generated from overlapping length-10 windows and do not represent customer/account histories.
No customer, account, merchant, or device identifiers are available for grouped leakage analysis or entity-level resampling.
The Autoencoder score is reconstruction error (anomaly score), not a calibrated fraud probability; reconstruction MSE and AP have different meanings.
Imported model provenance is incomplete, and LightGBM historical metric lineage is unresolved.
Latency, throughput, memory, transaction volume, alert capacity, serving costs, monitoring, and rollback behavior have not been measured or specified.
Previously examined test results cannot serve as independent confirmation.
